en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a sloping meadow above a town. Two women in traditional rural clothing work on the hillside with rakes. Tall conifer trees frame the foreground. In the middle ground is a church with a bell tower and other village buildings, surrounded by mountainous landscape. At the bottom margin, printed text reads "Cavalese - Panorama".
